annotations.title: Net salary: Greece vs the Netherlands

description: Take-home pay of a job in Greece (with the situation options of net_salary) next to a job in the Netherlands (2026, optionally with the 8% holiday allowance and the 30% ruling), in euros, with the difference a year.

age.description: Age; changes the result here (young-worker reliefs, senior slabs, surcharges). Default 35.

five_c.description: Article 5C relocation incentive. 50% of employment income exempt for 7 years after moving tax residence to Greece. Default false.

home_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in Greece, in EUR

nl_gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in the Netherlands, in euros, without holiday allowance

nl_holiday_allowance.description: The Dutch job pays 8% holiday allowance on top. Default true.

nl_thirty_percent_ruling.description: The 30% ruling applies in the Netherlands. Default false.
